paite: TOUPA lau peuhmahte'n nuam asa uh, alampi tawnte'n.
heading: TOUPA Thumanna A Kipahman
english: A Song of Ascents. Blessed is everyone who fears Yahweh, who walks in his ways.

paite: Na khut sepgim gah ne ding lah na hi ngal a; vualzawl in na om ding a, nang a ding in ahoih ding hi.
english: For you will eat the labor of your hands. You will be happy, and it will be well with you.

paite: Na zi na insung a grepgui gahpha bang ahi ding a; na tate na dohkan kim ah, olive selte bang ahi ding uh.
english: Your wife will be as a fruitful vine in the innermost parts of your house, your children like olive shoots around your table.

paite: Ngai in, TOUPA lau mi huchibang in vualzawl in a-om ding hi.
english: Behold, this is how the man who fears Yahweh is blessed.

paite: TOUPA'N Zion a pan in hon vualzawl ding hi; huchi in na damsung teng in Jerusalem hoihna na mu ding hi.
english: May Yahweh bless you out of Zion, and may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.

paite: Ahi, na tute na mu ding a, Israelte tung ah khamuanna om hen.
english: Yes, may you see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel.
